fact: UNHCR, with the government of Namibia, launched cash-based interventions delivered through MTC Namibia's mobile money service for refugees and asylum-seekers in Osire settlement, benefiting around 6,000 individuals and over 1,000 households.
source_slug: 2025-02-01 Cash-Based Interventions provide a ray of hope for refugees in Namibia amid severe drought and funding shortages
